description:
About the job

About Vidovo




Vidovo is a UGC and creator marketing platform. Brands come to us to get creator content that actually performs in paid social; creators come to us to work with real brands and get paid on time. We've worked with 400+ brands, including NerdWallet, OLIPOP, Physician's Choice, and Mid Day Squares, and our marketplace of 32,000+ creators is vetted by humans, not AI. Some clients run campaigns themselves on the platform; others hand us the keys through our managed service. Both need someone in their corner.




Role Description




You'll own the client experience after the deal closes: onboarding, day-to-day questions, check-in calls, campaign hiccups, and renewals.




Here's what a real week looks like. A creator goes quiet the week content is due and the brand has asked for an update three times. A client reviews 200 applicants and likes none of them. A managed client says a video "feels like an ad, not a testimonial" and wants to know how the next batch will be different. A self-serve brand hasn't logged in for three weeks and renews in nine days. Your job is to handle all of it with a real answer, a clear next step, and a date attached.




Right now, most of this runs through our founder. This hire exists to change that. You won't be routing questions upward; you'll be the person clients trust to just handle it.




What You'll Do

Own onboarding from kickoff to first campaign launch, for both self-serve and managed brands
Be the first responder in client Slack channels; answer the actual question, same day
Send proactive status updates that name names, counts, and ETAs, so clients never have to chase us
Hand-pick creators when a brand isn't loving their applicants; you'll develop a real point of view on who fits which brand and who doesn't
Sit in the middle between brands and creators: revisions, deadlines, and expectations, handled fairly in both directions
Watch account activity, spot quiet clients before renewal, and re-engage them with something specific, never a template
Run check-in calls with managed clients, and make the written update good enough that they don't need the call
Turn the questions we answer over and over into docs, and surface product feedback to the team




What We're Looking For

1-4 years in customer success, account management, or another client-facing role
Writing that's fast, specific, and warm; this is a Slack-first job and we will test your writing before we test anything else
Judgment: you make the reasonable call and explain it, rather than escalating everything
Taste, or the ability to build it quickly; you can look at a creator's profile and a brand's audience and say whether it's a fit, and why
Organized under volume; multiple accounts, multiple open loops, nothing dropped
Comfortable across Slack, Google Workspace, HubSpot, and ClickUp
Real interest in creator marketing, UGC, or paid social

title: Growth Operator (Ecommerce, SEO/GEO, Outbound)
description:
About the job

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.




Job Title: Growth Operator (Ecommerce, SEO/GEO, Outbound)




About the Company:

Our client is a fast-growing CPG wellness company operating two brands: a cold-pressed functional shot line and a sublingual electrolyte tablet line. They sell direct to consumer through Shopify and TikTok Shop, and through national retail including Whole Foods, GNC, Vitamin Shoppe, and 800+ airport retail locations via UNFI and Rainforest distribution. They are a small, fast, and automation-first company.




Job Description:

Our client is looking for one person to own the growth surface across both brands. This is a generalist role by design. You will not be handed a narrow function and a manager. You will be handed a set of outcomes and the tools to hit them. The right person is a strong ecommerce marketer with real technical SEO depth who is comfortable running outbound sequences. You should be genuinely fluent with AI tools, not just aware of them. We expect you to automate your own repetitive work.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Own SEO and GEO, including technical SEO, site architecture, schema markup, Core Web Vitals, indexation, internal linking.

• Develop keyword and entity strategy for a competitive supplements and wellness category.

• Manage content production and optimization, including AI-assisted drafting with human editing.

• Engage in Generative Engine Optimization: structure content and entity data so our brands get cited in AI answers across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.

• Own the Ahrefs Brand Radar dashboard and report on AI share of voice monthly.

• Operate outbound sequences to retail buyers, brokers, and distribution partners.

• Build and enrich target lists in Apollo and Clay.

• Maintain inbox and domain health: warmup, sending caps, SPF/DKIM/DMARC monitoring.

• Personalize outbound communication at the account level, focusing on quality over volume.

• Maintain product data, listings, and inventory-facing content across channels.

• Organize the creator affiliate program: outreach tracking, content collection, payouts coordination.

• Own SOPs for all tasks performed.

• Own organic and lifecycle performance across two Shopify stores.

• Manage email and SMS: flows, campaigns, segmentation, list health.

• Optimize product pages: copy, imagery, offers, reviews.

• Support paid social by producing creative concepts and briefs.

• Provide weekly reporting on traffic, conversion rate, AOV, and repeat rate.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Strong ecommerce marketing experience.

• Technical SEO depth.

• Comfort running outbound sequences.

• High fluency with AI tools in daily workflow.




Preferred Skills:

• Experience with Shopify and TikTok Shop.

• Familiarity with CPG wellness category.




Personality:

• Generalist mindset.

• Comfortable with ownership and direct access to leadership.

• Automation-first approach.

• Detail-oriented.




Software & Tools:

• Shopify

• TikTok Shop

• Ahrefs

• Apollo

• Clay

• AI tools (e.g., for drafting, automation)




Schedule:

Full-time




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Our client is building a next-generation publishing platform at the intersection of AI, creators, books, and social commerce. Their mission is to help individuals transform ideas into published books and distribute them through modern social commerce channels, creating new opportunities for authors, creators, and consumers alike.

As the company scales, they are investing heavily in creator-led growth and affiliate partnerships. They are seeking a Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead to own and scale a high-touch VIP creator program focused on driving product awareness, creator engagement, and revenue growth.

The Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead will serve as the primary owner of a VIP creator program designed to cultivate relationships with high-performing TikTok Shop affiliates, BookTok creators, and social commerce influencers.

title: Mobile Developer Senior
description:
About the job

En Kigo convertimos filas en flujo. Somos la llave de las ciudades inteligentes: identidad, accesos y pagos en una sola plataforma, conectada al mundo físico (barreras, torniquetes, cámaras, parquímetros) en 75+ ciudades, con 5.7M usuarios y 76M de operaciones al año.




Nuestra app es una pieza central de esa experiencia: pagos, accesos, QR, mapas, reservas, notificaciones y comunicación con infraestructura física en tiempo real. Buscamos un Senior Mobile Developer que nos ayude a llevarla al siguiente nivel: alguien fuerte técnicamente, obsesionado con la experiencia del usuario y capaz de hacerse dueño de una funcionalidad desde la arquitectura hasta producción.




Qué vas a hacer

Construir y evolucionar nuestra app en Flutter, trabajando en funcionalidades que conectan software con el mundo físico: QR, cámara, mapas, geolocalización, pagos, deep links, push notifications, Bluetooth y experiencias offline.




Esperamos hands-on real: diseñar soluciones, escribir código, revisar PRs, detectar problemas de performance, resolver crashes y tomar decisiones que mantengan una app utilizada a escala estable y rápida.




También vas a trabajar de cerca con Backend, Product, Design, QA e IoT para construir experiencias completas, no solamente pantallas.




Lo que buscamos

Experiencia sólida construyendo aplicaciones móviles que ya viven en producción, idealmente con una base importante de usuarios.




Dominio de Flutter y Dart, arquitectura mobile, state management, consumo de APIs, concurrencia, almacenamiento local y lifecycle de aplicaciones.




Experiencia resolviendo problemas reales de performance, estabilidad y compatibilidad entre dispositivos.

Buscamos alguien con criterio técnico, que pueda investigar un problema sin esperar instrucciones paso a paso, que sepa cuándo abstraer y cuándo mantener las cosas simples, y que entienda que una feature no termina cuando funciona en su teléfono: termina cuando funciona bien en producción.




Experiencia trabajando con código nativo en Swift/iOS y Kotlin/Android suma muchos puntos. Tenemos funcionalidades donde toca bajar a nativo, integrar SDKs, trabajar con permisos, capabilities del dispositivo y resolver problemas específicos de cada plataforma.




Nuestro stack mobile




Flutter, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Firebase, PostHog.




Integraciones con cámara, QR, mapas, geolocalización, push notifications, deep links, Bluetooth/BLE, biometría y capacidades nativas de iOS y Android.




Desarrollo spec-driven, testing automatizado, observabilidad de producción y product analytics. AI tooling auditado y gobernado.




AI no es opcional




Trabajamos con AI integrada en todo el ciclo: harness de desarrollo (Claude Code, Kiro), generación spec-driven, debugging, testing, code reviews y agentes en flujos reales.




Buscamos a alguien que ya use AI como parte natural de su forma de desarrollar, que sepa darle contexto, validar lo que genera y utilizarla para moverse más rápido sin sacrificar calidad.




También esperamos criterio sobre sus límites: seguridad, código sensible, datos de usuarios y saber qué se puede delegar y qué requiere revisión humana.

About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer team owns the Kraken app experience used by millions of traders and crypto newcomers worldwide, the product that turns someone's first crypto curiosity into a long-term relationship with Kraken. We build the interfaces people actually use to buy, sell, manage their portfolio, and interact with their assets. Our stack is React on web and React Native on mobile, and we ship fast, measure everything, and iterate based on real user behaviour. We work agile, globally distributed, and we care as much about why we build something as how we build it.

We're looking for a world-class Senior Frontend Engineer to join our product-minded engineering team: we care about customer problems, measurable outcomes, frontend craft, and fast iteration. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We're hiring a Growth Product Manager (Senior to Staff level) to help us achieve our big vision that everyone who makes music has a DistroKid account.

Navigate the full funnel to achieve our growth goals, including acquisition, onboarding, activation, retention, reactivation, and referrals
Conduct experiments end to end: hypothesis, instrumentation, analysis, iteration, and knowing when to stop
Use AI tooling to compress the loop from idea to shipped experiment, multiplying what a small, nimble team can ship
Keep the executive team clear on what you're doing, why, and what you're trading off
Learn from the top consumer growth teams and bring back what works
Help PMs and marketers across the company surface and clear their own growth blockers
Use and iterate on the artist tools and promo assets we already have to build organic and viral growth loops.

5+ years in product or growth, with 3+ years owning a subscriber, revenue, or retention KPI at a scaled consumer or self-serve software company

about lumina. 

Lumina is a technology-enabled hospitality company operating a curated portfolio of boutique hotels, luxury villas, and design-led residences across Mexico, the United States, and the Dominican Republic. the role.

description:
About the job

About Us

At Pencil, we are building the AI Operating System for marketing - the only enterprise platform that aggregates every leading AI model, enforces enterprise-grade governance, and turns creative production savings into media growth. Our work moves brands like Diageo, L’Oréal and Unilever from creative brief to live, on-brand, performance-tested campaigns in minutes - across every market, channel and language - without sacrificing legal, IT or brand control.

Your mission

Bring the craft of advertising together with the speed of GenAI. You build and operate agentic and nodal creative workflows - connecting insight, concept, copy, imagery and video into scalable systems - so our creative teams and clients can move from idea to finished advertising faster, without losing quality or strategic grounding.

You work day-to-day under the direction of Art Directors and Creative Directors, bringing deep hands-on fluency in GenAI tools and workflows to their briefs. You're not setting creative vision - you're the person in the room who knows how to make the technology deliver on it.

This track is for people who go deep on the systems side - building, scaling, and governing the agents, workflows, and creative infrastructure that creative teams and clients rely on. Creative sensibility still matters (they need to understand what "good creative output" means to build for it), but the growth path is technical leadership and architecture, not creative direction.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery & Requirements


Meet with clients, creative teams, and stakeholders to understand workflows, challenges, and operational requirements
Facilitate workflow audits and capability assessments
Identify where GenAI, agents, or automation can meaningfully improve quality, efficiency, or scale
Translate operational challenges into technical implementation plans


Agent, Workflow & System Architecture


Design and build production-grade prompts, workflows, agents, and creative systems
Develop repeatable, scalable frameworks that support multiple brands, markets, and channels
Own workflow governance, quality control, and reliability of deployed systems
Establish technical standards and best practices for how agents and workflows are built and maintained


Enablement & Technical Adoption


Lead training, workshops, and office hours to help teams adopt new systems
Own technical documentation, playbooks, and guides for internal and client use
Support change management as new tools and workflows roll out
Act as the technical authority on GenAI capabilities, limitations, and constraints


Platform Evaluation & Technical Innovation


Evaluate emerging AI models, platforms, and tooling for technical fit and scalability
Stress-test new capabilities and provide structured, technical feedback to Product and Engineering
Identify architectural improvements to existing agents, workflows, and systems
Represent the technical roadmap for creative technology internally


What We’re Looking For


2-3 years’ experience in advertising creative development
Experience with GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Gemini etc.
Experience with GenAI techniques such as model selection & prompting
Any experience using GenAI to deliver real-world advertising creative
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud
Good personal communication and management skills
Preference for candidates who have prior agency experience
Strong written English skills, allowing you to communicate effectively with clients and team
Access to a reliable computer with an internet connection exceeding 40 Mbps
A collaborative and team-oriented attitude with optimism about the role of GenAI in creativity


What Growth Looks Like


Art Director: owns creative direction across projects, sets visual/conceptual standards, mentors on craft.
Creative Director: sets creative vision across accounts or brands, owns creative quality at scale.
Head of Creative: sets the creative bar and point of view for the organization.

About the job

Role Title: Graphic Designer - Editorial, Poster & Marketing Layout




Role Type: Contractor




Location: Remote




micro1 is selecting Graphic Designer - Editorial, Poster & Marketing Layout specialists to contribute to a client project focused on design analysis and annotation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters. You'll be immersed in a frontier AI initiative, using your deep knowledge of design composition to annotate, describe, and structure assets across print, digital, and motion media. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills are key to providing accurate, industry-standard insights and annotations.




Scope of Work




Annotate editorial, poster, and marketing design assets as well as short video clips, following a defined schema and leveraging precise visual and design vocabulary.
Deconstruct completed designs into compositional layers, populating structured metadata reflecting hierarchy, geometry, style, and typographic systems.
Apply cinematography and composition standards to video clips, using industry language to describe framing, movement, and visual flow.
Create exemplar annotations that serve as quality benchmarks for the project's evolving dataset.
Identify and document ambiguous cases, missing categories, or annotation schema edge cases for ongoing guideline improvement.
Maintain alignment with project leads and quality control throughout updates to annotation frameworks.
Use Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and similar tools to evaluate, process, and structure layered design files as part of the annotation workflow.




Preferred Qualifications




3–5+ years as a graphic designer, visual/brand designer, layout or print specialist, editorial designer, or art director; contributors with 7+ years or art direction expertise are encouraged for quality leadership tracks.
Portfolio demonstrating advanced use of typography, color, layout, and visual hierarchy, particularly in editorial and marketing contexts.
Expert-level proficiency with Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, After Effects), Canva, or equivalent design platforms.
Ability to articulate and document design concepts with precision, using established design and composition terminology.
Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or equivalent professional portfolio demonstrating relevant expertise.

Background in poster, editorial, or marketing layout design, with added value from motion design, video editing, or cinematography experience.

Your mission

Bring the craft of advertising together with the speed of GenAI. You build and operate agentic and nodal creative workflows - connecting insight, concept, copy, imagery and video into scalable systems - so our creative teams and clients can move from idea to finished advertising faster, without losing quality or strategic grounding.

You work day-to-day under the direction of Art Directors and Creative Directors, bringing deep hands-on fluency in GenAI tools and workflows to their briefs. You're not setting creative vision - you're the person in the room who knows how to make the technology deliver on it.

This track is for people who go deep on the systems side - building, scaling, and governing the agents, workflows, and creative infrastructure that creative teams and clients rely on. You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.

Bachelor's degree.

Verificar la identidad del cliente y validar datos base de contacto de acuerdo con los procedimientos y controles operativos autorizados, antes de comunicar cualquier información de la oferta.

Confirmar la elegibilidad y condiciones de la oferta precalificada (producto, monto/línea, vigencia, condiciones clave) en los sistemas y herramientas autorizados, evitando promesas fuera de lo autorizado.

Obtener y registrar el consentimiento del cliente para continuar con la gestión comercial y el tratamiento/uso de información, conforme a los lineamientos internos y regulatorios aplicables.

Gestionar dudas e inquietudes sobre el producto ofrecido, explicando alcances y pasos del proceso; canalizar correctamente solicitudes fuera de alcance (aclaraciones, quejas, temas operativos) al área correspondiente.
Ejecutar la colocación/solicitud siguiendo el guion (script) y el flujo definido para ofertas precalificadas, cuidando que la información capturada sea consistente y completa.

Registrar de forma correcta, completa y oportuna cada interacción en los sistemas autorizados: resultado de llamada, estatus de venta, motivos de rechazo/no contacto, acuerdos, seguimiento y evidencias requeridas.
Cumplir con objetivos individuales de ventas, conversión, productividad y calidad, tales como contactos efectivos, tasa de cierre, cumplimiento de script, calidad de captura y auditorías de llamada.

Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas internas, controles operativos, estándares de conducta y normativa aplicable en México, incluyendo confidencialidad/privacidad de datos, prácticas de venta responsable y comunicación transparente.
Contribuir a un ambiente de control interno sólido, identificando y reportando oportunamente incidentes, desviaciones, posibles fraudes, malas prácticas, riesgos operativos o quejas del cliente.
Brindar una experiencia positiva durante todo el contacto: trato respetuoso, lenguaje claro, ritmo adecuado, empatía, y cierre cordial independientemente del resultado.
Participar en calibraciones, coaching y capacitación continua, aplicando retroalimentación para mejorar argumentación, calidad de llamada y resultados.
Orientación a resultados y disciplina diaria.
Resiliencia ante el rechazo.
Comunicación persuasiva: escucha, adapta el mensaje y concreta el siguiente paso.
Mejora continúa basada en métricas.
Colabora y comparte feedback (objeciones, mensajes que funcionan)..
Aprende y aporta (roleplays, mejores prácticas)
Cualificar rápido y manejar objeciones.
Cumplimiento y trato justo al cliente (privacidad y comunicaciones).
Bachillerato trunco o concluido en administración, mercadotecnia, ventas o áreas afines
Experiencia previa en ventas telefónicas, call center o atención a clientes
Habilidad para comunicarse de forma efectiva con claridad y fluidez verbal
Enfoque a resultados y cumplimiento de objetivos comerciales
Habilidades de persuasión negociación y manejo de objeciones
Capacidad de escucha activa y orientación al cliente

skills: Generate and manage purchase orders and delivery schedules to global Bosch supplying plants based on customer demand and inventory targets.
Maintain 24+ months of rolling demand visibility in SAP and/or Kinaxis Maestro to support long-range capacity planning at supplying plants.
Coordinate with supplying plants on allocation priorities, capacity constraints, shortages, engineering changes, and EOP transitions.
Monitor inbound order confirmations and proactively escalate mismatches between confirmed and required quantities.
Maintain planning master data: lead times, MOQs, lot sizes, safety stock levels, and MRP controller assignments.
Coordinate inbound receipts, inventory positioning, and stock availability across North American warehouse locations.
Monitor and resolve blocked stock, MRP exceptions, and inventory discrepancies with warehouse operations teams.
Manage goods-in-transit (GIT) visibility and ensure timely clearance of open inbound deliveries.
Support warehouse operations through accurate ASN transmission, delivery scheduling, and outbound shipment prioritization.
Identify slow-moving and obsolete inventory in partnership with warehouse teams; develop disposition strategies.
Manage customer-facing planning for OEM and Tier 1 accounts across automotive, powersports, and commercial vehicle segments.
Process and validate customer EDI releases; ensure accurate system intake and timely order fulfillment.
Transmit and validate Advance Shipping Notifications (ASNs) through customer portals per customer-specific requirements.
Schedule outbound shipments and monitor deliveries through final customer destination.
Proactively communicate supply risks to customers with recovery timelines and viable alternatives.
Support shortage escalations with structured root cause analysis and corrective action documentation.
Execute and manage MRP runs in SAP to generate planned orders and purchase requisitions based on production demand.
Convert MRP requirements into purchase orders or scheduling agreements aligned with supplier lead times and production schedules.
Maintain planning master data: MRP type, lot sizes, lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and MRP controller assignments.
Monitor and action MRP exception messages (expedite, defer, cancel) to keep supply plans aligned with evolving demand.
Maintain data governance standards in SAP for assigned material portfolio, including parameter integrity and proper controller assignment.
Manage purchase orders and scheduling agreements with external suppliers, ensuring on-time delivery to plant locations.
Communicate demand requirements, changes, and escalations to suppliers in a clear and timely manner.
Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively address shortages, late deliveries, and quality holds.
Coordinate with Purchasing and Supplier Quality on corrective actions, capacity constraints, and alternate source qualification.
Support new supplier onboarding and system configuration in ERP.
Monitor stock levels at point-of-use and receiving locations to ensure uninterrupted production supply.
Manage critical shortage situations with structured recovery plans communicated to plant operations and management.
Participate in shortage review meetings with structured updates on open issues and resolution timelines.
Coordinate expedited shipments when necessary; ensure premium freight is justified, approved, and documented.
Track goods-in-transit and ensure timely customs clearance for imported materials.
Maintain inventory levels (DIO) in alignment with working capital and service level objectives.
Perform ABC/XYZ material classification and define inventory strategies based on criticality, demand volatility, and margin.
Identify excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; recommend and execute disposition strategies.
Support safety stock reviews and planning parameter optimization on a defined cadence.
Manage inventory risk through product lifecycle transitions: new launches, engineering changes, and end-of-production.
Monitor and report KPIs relevant to assigned track: OTIF, backlog, premium freight, fill rate, supplier OTD, and DIO.
Analyze forecast vs. actual deviations to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Prepare structured input for weekly shortage reviews, monthly business reviews (MBR), and customer/plant scorecards.
Develop root cause analysis and corrective action documentation for supply disruptions and service failures.
Use SAP, Kinaxis Maestro, and Power BI to maintain real-time planning and performance visibility.
Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Quality, and Purchasing to align supply plans with business priorities.
Manage premium freight requests through the iStar approval process; ensure spend is justified, documented, and minimized.
Contribute demand and supply input to the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.
Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities across planning processes, system usage, and cross-functional workflows.
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in supply chain planning, materials management, or procurement within a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Hands-on SAP ERP experience at the transaction level (planning, purchasing, or inventory management context).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and planning scenario modeling (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, etc.).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable planning decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to communicate professionally during escalation situations.
Results-oriented with strong ownership mindset, urgency, and attention to detail.
Flexible worker, operates well working both independently and in a team environment.
Automotive OEM or Tier 1 customer experience (e.g., BMW, DTNA, Toyota, Ford, Harley-Davidson, BRP, Polaris).
Experience managing EDI releases, ASN transmission, and customer portal compliance.
Familiarity with managing internal plant-to-plant supplier relationships within a global manufacturing organization.
Experience with premium freight management and cost-reduction disciplines.
Working knowledge of MRP logic, BOM structures, and production planning fundamentals.
Experience with external supplier coordination and scheduling agreement management.
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles (kanban, PFEP, pull systems, standard work).
Experience with foreign supplier coordination, import logistics, or customs compliance basics.

description:
About the job

Company Description

Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the change to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch!

Job Description

The Supply Chain Planner — Customer & Procurement manages material flow across the North American supply chain on behalf of Bosch customers, plant operations, and internal logistics. Depending on business needs and team structure, this role may be assigned to one or both of the following tracks: Passthrough (Customer) Planning or Procurement (Raw Material) Planning. Planners are expected to develop competency in both areas over time, enabling organizational flexibility as business requirements evolve.

Assignment Note: Individual planners will be designated to a primary track based on team structure and business need. This JD covers both tracks to support role mobility and cross-training across the planning organization.

Track A: Customer & Passthrough Planning

Procure finished goods from global Bosch supplying plants → Manage warehouse inbound → Fulfill OEM/Tier 1 customer demand

A1. Inbound Planning & Procurement from Bosch Supplying Plants


Generate and manage purchase orders and delivery schedules to global Bosch supplying plants based on customer demand and inventory targets.
Maintain 24+ months of rolling demand visibility in SAP and/or Kinaxis Maestro to support long-range capacity planning at supplying plants.
Coordinate with supplying plants on allocation priorities, capacity constraints, shortages, engineering changes, and EOP transitions.
Monitor inbound order confirmations and proactively escalate mismatches between confirmed and required quantities.
Maintain planning master data: lead times, MOQs, lot sizes, safety stock levels, and MRP controller assignments.


A2. Warehouse Coordination (Summerville, SC & Laredo, TX)


Coordinate inbound receipts, inventory positioning, and stock availability across North American warehouse locations.
Monitor and resolve blocked stock, MRP exceptions, and inventory discrepancies with warehouse operations teams.
Manage goods-in-transit (GIT) visibility and ensure timely clearance of open inbound deliveries.
Support warehouse operations through accurate ASN transmission, delivery scheduling, and outbound shipment prioritization.
Identify slow-moving and obsolete inventory in partnership with warehouse teams; develop disposition strategies.


A3. Customer Management & Order Fulfillment


Manage customer-facing planning for OEM and Tier 1 accounts across automotive, powersports, and commercial vehicle segments.
Process and validate customer EDI releases; ensure accurate system intake and timely order fulfillment.
Transmit and validate Advance Shipping Notifications (ASNs) through customer portals per customer-specific requirements.
Schedule outbound shipments and monitor deliveries through final customer destination.
Proactively communicate supply risks to customers with recovery timelines and viable alternatives.
Support shortage escalations with structured root cause analysis and corrective action documentation.


Track B: Procurement & Raw Material Planning

Translate production demand into supplier orders → Ensure uninterrupted material supply → Protect manufacturing continuity

B1. MRP-Driven Procurement Planning


Execute and manage MRP runs in SAP to generate planned orders and purchase requisitions based on production demand.
Convert MRP requirements into purchase orders or scheduling agreements aligned with supplier lead times and production schedules.
Maintain planning master data: MRP type, lot sizes, lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and MRP controller assignments.
Monitor and action MRP exception messages (expedite, defer, cancel) to keep supply plans aligned with evolving demand.
Maintain data governance standards in SAP for assigned material portfolio, including parameter integrity and proper controller assignment.


B2. Supplier Coordination & Order Management


Manage purchase orders and scheduling agreements with external suppliers, ensuring on-time delivery to plant locations.
Communicate demand requirements, changes, and escalations to suppliers in a clear and timely manner.
Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively address shortages, late deliveries, and quality holds.
Coordinate with Purchasing and Supplier Quality on corrective actions, capacity constraints, and alternate source qualification.
Support new supplier onboarding and system configuration in ERP.


B3. Production Supply & Shortage Management


Monitor stock levels at point-of-use and receiving locations to ensure uninterrupted production supply.
Manage critical shortage situations with structured recovery plans communicated to plant operations and management.
Participate in shortage review meetings with structured updates on open issues and resolution timelines.
Coordinate expedited shipments when necessary; ensure premium freight is justified, approved, and documented.
Track goods-in-transit and ensure timely customs clearance for imported materials.


Applies to Both Tracks

Inventory Management & Optimization


Maintain inventory levels (DIO) in alignment with working capital and service level objectives.
Perform ABC/XYZ material classification and define inventory strategies based on criticality, demand volatility, and margin.
Identify excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; recommend and execute disposition strategies.
Support safety stock reviews and planning parameter optimization on a defined cadence.
Manage inventory risk through product lifecycle transitions: new launches, engineering changes, and end-of-production.


Performance Monitoring & Reporting


Monitor and report KPIs relevant to assigned track: OTIF, backlog, premium freight, fill rate, supplier OTD, and DIO.
Analyze forecast vs. actual deviations to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Prepare structured input for weekly shortage reviews, monthly business reviews (MBR), and customer/plant scorecards.
Develop root cause analysis and corrective action documentation for supply disruptions and service failures.
Use SAP, Kinaxis Maestro, and Power BI to maintain real-time planning and performance visibility.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Quality, and Purchasing to align supply plans with business priorities.
Manage premium freight requests through the iStar approval process; ensure spend is justified, documented, and minimized.
Contribute demand and supply input to the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.
Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities across planning processes, system usage, and cross-functional workflows.


Qualifications

Required - All Planners


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in supply chain planning, materials management, or procurement within a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Hands-on SAP ERP experience at the transaction level (planning, purchasing, or inventory management context).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and planning scenario modeling (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, etc.).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable planning decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to communicate professionally during escalation situations.
Results-oriented with strong ownership mindset, urgency, and attention to detail.
Flexible worker, operates well working both independently and in a team environment.


Preferred - Track A (Passthrough / Customer Planning)


Automotive OEM or Tier 1 customer experience (e.g., BMW, DTNA, Toyota, Ford, Harley-Davidson, BRP, Polaris).
Experience managing EDI releases, ASN transmission, and customer portal compliance.
Familiarity with managing internal plant-to-plant supplier relationships within a global manufacturing organization.
Experience with premium freight management and cost-reduction disciplines.


Preferred - Track B (Procurement / Raw Material Planning)


Working knowledge of MRP logic, BOM structures, and production planning fundamentals.
Experience with external supplier coordination and scheduling agreement management.
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles (kanban, PFEP, pull systems, standard work).
Experience with foreign supplier coordination, import logistics, or customs compliance basics.

About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT 

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity 

Join PepsiCo's North America Beverage Contract Operations team and play a key role in ensuring billing accuracy, financial integrity, and exceptional customer service across our beverage network. As a Supply Chain Operations Analyst, you will investigate and resolve post-shipment billing discrepancies, manage operational requests, and collaborate with multiple stakeholders to ensure accurate transactions, timely resolutions, and a seamless customer experience. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise in supply chain operations, invoicing processes, SAP migration initiatives, and data-driven decision making while supporting one of PepsiCo's largest businesses.

Your Impact 


Investigate and resolve post-shipment billing discrepancies raised by bottlers and franchise partners, validating quantities, shipments, inventory records, and delivery information.
Ensure accurate processing of credits, debits, returns, and invoice adjustments while protecting PepsiCo's financial accuracy and compliance.
Manage requests received through the SPA mailbox, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving inquiries within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Coordinate with Inventory, Finance, Customer Service, and Operations teams to gather information, resolve issues, and communicate updates to stakeholders.
Support Reverse Logistics activities, including product returns, documentation management, and coordination with distribution centers and inventory teams.
Process sample orders requested by Marketing and other business partners, ensuring accurate execution and timely delivery.
Monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reporting accuracy, and customer experience.
Utilize Excel, Power BI, and business systems to analyze data, support reporting activities, and drive process improvements.
Contribute to ongoing business transformation initiatives, including report migrations and process enhancements as part of the SAP transition.


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For? 


Advanced English required, both written and verbal.
6 months to 1 year of experience in Supply Chain Operations, Order Management, Billing, Inventory, or related operational environments.
Intermediate Excel skills, including formulas, filters, pivot tables, charts, conditional formatting, and data cleansing.
Working knowledge of Power BI, including reporting and dashboard analysis.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Logistics, or a related field.


If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs. 
Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning. 
Development programs according to Leadership skills. 
Specialized training according to the role. 
Learning experiences with internal and external providers. 
We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others. 
Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life. 
A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle. 
And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others. 


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.

Bachelor's degree.

title: Creator Operations Manager - TikTok LIVE
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
About TikTok LIVE
TikTok LIVE's mission is to work hand-in-hand with creators & influencers, agencies, and partner organizations to build an environment that connects communities in real time, enabling meaningful and interactive connections around the globe.

What You'll Do
Creators are at the heart of our ecosystem. As a Creator Operations Manager, you will be responsible for building, activating, and retaining a healthy creator community on TikTok LIVE. You will design and execute scalable operational strategies that empower creators to thrive, while ensuring sustainable growth and high-quality content supply.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute scalable creator programs to onboard, educate, and activate TikTok LIVE creators, driving sustainable platform growth.
- Design and implement incentive programs, campaigns, and reward systems to boost creator participation and improve retention rates.
- Craft tailored content and growth strategies targeting diverse creator segments to maximize performance across tiers.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Partnerships, Campaigns, Product, and Strategy—to align on creator growth initiatives.
- Partner with vendors and internal teams to create creator toolkits, educational materials, and training resources.
- Monitor and analyze creator funnel metrics (onboarding, activity, retention) to identify friction points and optimize operational workflows.
- Act as the primary source of creator insights, delivering data-driven recommendations to influence strategy and business decisions.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications: 
- 3+ years of experience in creator operations, content operations, influencer management, digital marketing, or related fields in a platform or agency environment.
- Data-driven mindset with solid analytical skills; experience with performance tracking and funnel optimization.
- Strong operational and project management skills with the ability to execute programs at scale.
- Hands-on, proactive, and adaptable to fast-paced environments.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficiency in English and Spanish; this role requires frequent communication LATAM teams, clients, and stakeholders to ensure smooth collaboration across key regions. 

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in the live streaming industry, creator economy, or community-centric platforms.
- Expertise in designing creator incentive programs and growth frameworks.
- Strong business acumen with the ability to translate insights into actionable growth strategies.
- Deep understanding of digital content trends, monetization models, and creator engagement best practices.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

description:
About the job

We are Deoleo. The Olive Oil Company

For centuries, our olive oil has been a staple of kitchens around the globe. Armed with knowledge and passion, we are focused on producing quality olive oil and leading our industry into a more sustainable future.




Deoleo is the world’s largest olive oil company with world leading brands such as Carbonell, Bertolli and Carapelli. Producing our oil in Spain and Italy; and distributing our brands from Australia to Alaska. We´re a multinational company with offices in many locations, headquartered in Madrid, Spain.




Our mission is to nurture healthier futures by making Mediterranean goodness available to all.

Our ambition is to be the undisputed leader of the olive oil industry.




Without compromising traditional flavors, the company strive to offer premium-quality products in line with today’s lifestyles. All Deoleo’s brands meet and exceed the extensive, strict quality requirements of the International Olive Council (IOC), the European Union (EU). Beyond olive oil, Deoleo products include premium vinegars and the finest table olives available.




DEOLEO is committed to making a positive impact on the planet and the people we serve, ensuring that every drop of our olive oil is produced with care and respect so our purpose in sustainability is Caring for cares for you. For Deoleo, sustainability is more than just a buzz word – it is the key to adding value to our brands, our society and our planet. To continue making quality products that delight consumers, we must work in ways that preserves the environment and support the people that make our business possible. Thinking and acting sustainably is the key to nurturing a healthier future.




What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Brand Manager Carapelli & local jewels with analytics skills and business vision to join our Global Business Development Team in our Global Headquarter (Madrid).




Mission

Lead the development and execution of the marketing strategy for Carapelli, the primary and most strategic brand within the role scope, driving sustainable growth through consumer understanding, innovation, communication and commercial activation. In parallel, support the development and execution of strategic initiatives for the Local Jewels portfolio, including Figaro (Dominican Republic), Bertolli and Sublime (LATAM), ensuring each brand maximizes its growth potential and contributes to regional business objectives.




Key Responsibilities

• Develop and execute Carapelli's annual marketing plan while ensuring the achievement of the brand's 3-year strategic objectives and its alignment with global business objectives

• Develop and implement growth plans, innovation initiatives and communication strategies for Local Jewels.

• Analyze consumer, market and competitive data to identify growth opportunities across Carapelli and Local Jewels.

• Track business KPIs including sales, market share, distribution and ROI.

• Coordinate communication campaigns, product launches and brand activations.

• Partner with Sales, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain and Finance teams to ensure flawless execution for Carapelli.

• Lead, align and coordinate with regional commercial and trade marketing teams to identify growth opportunities, drive tactical initiatives and maximize brand performance and on time execution across assigned markets for Local Jewels.

• Manage external agencies including creative, media and digital partners.

• Monitor digital campaign performance and social media initiatives.

• Support innovation and portfolio development projects.

• Prepare business reviews, presentations and recommendations for local, regional and global stakeholders.

• Manage and monitor marketing budgets across assigned brands.

• Act as a key support partner to the Head of Marketing by coordinating strategic projects, preparing business analyses and executive presentations, and ensuring timely follow-up of priority initiatives across the organization.




You will need

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration or related field.




Experience:

• At least 4 years in FMCG marketing roles such as Assistant Brand Manager, Brand Executive or Marketing Coordinator.

• Proven experience on effectively executing integrated marketing communications brand plans and its KPIs performance tracking.

• Desirable previous experience in executing digital campaigns.

• Capacity to analyse at a deep level and connect data from different sources to drive actionable decisions.

• Nielsen/ISCAM and Kantar data management

• MS Office: P. Point and Excel Upper-Intermediate or Advanced




Competencies:

• Good analytical and communication skills (storytelling and presentation skills)

• Ownership and accountability

• Proactivity and results orientation

• Communication and storytelling

• Project management and prioritization

• Collaboration and teamwork

• High commitment level & team player

• English: Intermediate to Advanced

• Proven ability to lead projects, influence decisions and mobilize cross-functional teams




Our DEOLEO “Live Green” benefits will include:

DEOLEO Welcome basket, with some of our key products & brands (Carbonell, Koipe, Hojiblanca)
DEOLEO Live Green digital tour with specific focus on bring life our end-to-end processes (from harvest to bottle)
Fruit in the office
DEOLEO Employee platform discounts with lots of offers to get discount in hotels, supermarkets, car insurance, etc...
Access to our Deoleo Learning Academy where you can experience the power of inspirational online assessments and courses. Our training is designed to stimulate the development of all the key competences to face the challenges of today and tomorrow, we have more than a hundred courses available.




Be part of DEOLEO Team and you will find:

Leadership: We lead the way and empower everyone to get job done no matter position or level in DEOLEO.
Diversity: We work in a place where everyone can fit-in, embracing everyone contribution.
Sustainability: We act in the best interest of Olive Oil sustainable future.
Resilience: We can adapt and react with speed without losing focus on the results.




If you believe you match these values, we are looking forward to meeting you! We are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds.




At DEOLEO we believe that diversity adds incredible value to our teams, our products, and our culture. And therefore, DIVERSITY is one of our key values. We know that the best ideas and solutions come by bringing together people from all over the world and by fostering a culture of inclusion where everyone feels heard and has the chance to make a real impact.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, analytically sharp brand analyst to be the operational backbone of the Brand Strategy team. You will manage the BHT, support brief coordination, conduct competitive and cultural research, and produce the analytical inputs that allow the Brand Strategy Lead and Brand Strategy Sr Manager to stay focused on strategy.

In this role, you'll be...


STRATEGY & EXECUTION 
Coordinate and operate BHT waves: collect data from the Insights team, update dashboards, flag brand attribute movements, and maintain version control
Prepare regular competitive benchmarking reports — track how leading digital financial brands communicate across paid, owned, and earned channels
Prepare post-campaign performance summaries tied to brand OKRs — compile data from analytics tools and agency reports
Research cultural trends, category moments, and audience insights to feed into brand strategy planning sessions
Support preparation of strategy presentations and decks for brand reviews, stakeholder meetings, and agency briefings
Maintain brand documentation: tone-of-voice guides, messaging frameworks, and service-specific territory files across DiDi financial services
Cross-train fully on Brand Strategy Sr Manager responsibilities 



 CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION 


Support the Brand Strategy Manager and Brand Strategist Sr in documenting and tracking business team inputs — compile OKRs, priorities, and campaign requests from business teams so the brand team can act on them with speed and accuracy
Coordinate logistics with the external Insights team: send research requests, follow up on deliverables, organize study outputs, and prepare summaries for the team
Support brief documentation: format briefs, manage version control, and maintain the active brief file library
Assist in preparing materials that the Brand Strategist Sr takes to creative agency meetings



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


3–5 years of experience in brand management, marketing strategy, or a planning role at an agency or in-house team
Experience operating brand tracking tools or coordinating research projects is highly valued
Strong analytical mindset — comfortable working with data from multiple sources and synthesizing it into clear summaries
Excellent attention to detail and documentation skills
Proficiency in PowerPoint or Google Slides and Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and presentation building
Proactive and self-directed — able to manage recurring tasks independently without constant guidance
Fluent in English and Spanish



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About the job

Altamira Trade AG is seeking experienced professionals interested in building a long-term career in the metals and minerals trading industry.




We are offering one position within our Trader Development Programme-Mexico, a structured two-year training and development initiative based in Bolivia. The programme is designed to prepare future traders for opportunities across Altamira's global trading platform, including Mexico and other international markets.




Key Requirements-

• Minimum 3 years of experience in commodities traffic, operations, logistics, or contract administration.

• Strong knowledge of the metals and minerals sector.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Willingness to relocate to Bolivia for the duration of the programme.

• Strong analytical, commercial, and communication skills.




Selection Process

CV screening.
Written assessment.
Technical and commercial interviews.
Final assessment in Mexico city,Mexico.




Programme Structure

Phase 1

Participants will join the Altamira Bolivia traffic desk, gaining hands-on experience in contract administration, logistics, and operational execution.




Phase 2

Participants will progressively assume commercial responsibilities, manage customer and supplier relationships, and contribute to business development activities, including regular travel to mining regions across Bolivia.




Upon successful completion of the programme, participants will be considered for trader opportunities within Altamira's global trading network, including Mexico and other locations where business needs and opportunities exist.




How to Apply

Applications will be accepted until 15 October 2026.

Please send your one page pdf format CV to jesus.pineda@altamiratrade.com with the subject line:

Trader Development Programme-Mexico Application

Altamira Trade AG is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants.
